regions.title: Timor-Leste
regions.desc: The flagship implementation of Peskas since 2016, officially adopted as the national fisheries monitoring system in 2019. In partnership with the Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries, Peskas has collected over 59,000 fishing trips and 298 tonnes of catch data, enabling the first national fisheries production estimates and supporting evidence-based policy development for sustainable small-scale fisheries management.

regions.title: Malaysia
regions.desc: Peskas is being adapted for Malaysia's diverse coastal and marine fisheries systems. Building on lessons learned from Timor-Leste, the Malaysian implementation focuses on integrating with existing fisheries management frameworks while maintaining the platform's core open-source principles and user-centered design approach.

regions.title: Kenya
regions.desc:
Developed with the Kenya Fisheries Service (KEFS) and built on its catch assessment survey along the coast. The dashboard shows what is caught and what it is worth in each district, the species and sizes landed, how fishing gears compare, and the share of vulnerable species. Fleet-wide catch is estimated both with GPS trackers and with FAO's ARTFISH method. Open to everyone, in English and Swahili.

regions.title: Zanzibar
regions.desc:
Developed with the Zanzibar Fisheries and Marine Resources Research Institute (ZAFIRI), whose enumerators record landings at sites across Unguja and Pemba. The dashboard shows what is caught and what it is worth in each district, the species and sizes landed, how fishing gears compare, and the share of vulnerable species. Fleet-wide catch is estimated both with GPS trackers and with FAO's ARTFISH method. Open to everyone, in English and Swahili.

[What is new in the dashboards](/blog/dashboard-upgrade)

regions.title: Mozambique
regions.desc:
Developed with DINAPA, Mozambique's National Directorate of Fisheries and Aquaculture, and built on its landing survey in districts along the coast, from Cabo Delgado to Maputo. The dashboard shows what is caught and what it is worth in each district, the species and sizes landed, how fishing gears compare, and the share of vulnerable species. Fleet-wide catch is estimated both with GPS trackers and with FAO's ARTFISH method. Open to everyone, in Portuguese, English and Swahili.

[What is new in the dashboards](/blog/dashboard-upgrade)

regions.title: Malawi
regions.desc: Extending Peskas to inland fisheries, Malawi represents an important expansion into freshwater aquatic food systems. The Lake Malawi implementation adapts the platform's methodologies for inland small-scale fisheries, addressing unique challenges of freshwater ecosystems and community-based fisheries management.
